header: THE PAGE OF ALL THE UTILITY SERVICES has no topic of its own, like the list of calculators (menu.ts): it is the page that lists every topic of the registry, A to Z (src/components/tools/UtilityServicesPage.tsx). These are its words and its sample question. A line opens it when EVERY word is one of SERVICES_WORDS and at least one is a key: "utility services", "utilities", "all utilities", "list of utilities". I changed "utilities" to open this page, which has the calculators in it; it used to open the list of calculators (menu.ts).
